race.description: Picklebet Home Of Top 4 Betting Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: BRUTIFY (7) lifted strongly to get the prize by 2 lengths three runs back at this track before filling a minor placing in her last two starts. Won't need to do any more to take a power of catching again. HUSTLE (5) hasn't raced since finishing fourth at Ballarat Synthetic over 1100m five-and-a-half weeks ago. Kept ticking over with a placing in a recent trial at Flemington and maps ideally, should be right there. MORE HIGHS ON ME (8) finished second two runs back at this track then improved last time out to score by a nose over 1300m at this track. Can go on with it. ISDELL (1) showed good early speed from the inside draw last start before finishing third over 1400m at Ballarat Synthetic. Racing consistently and with even luck early he can give a sight.
